notes: SAS_HW4/HW4.sas, byte-identical: three inline DATALINES datasets (traffic 15 rows, lettuce 16, adrenal 18) each analysed with PROC GLM. One-way ANOVA on traffic signal delay with LSMEANS/CONTRAST/MEANS (Brown-Forsythe hovtest, Tukey/LSD/Bonferroni), a one-way model on lettuce with orthogonal Linear/Quadratic contrasts, and a two-way Stage*Treatment model with interaction LSMEANS. Fully self-contained; no edits.
